verdict.rationale: llama.cpp documents a plain C/C++ runtime with no dependencies and ships pre-built binaries, so the 'lightweight runtime binary' part is well supported. Community users praise the dependency-free build and the mmap loading-time improvement as a large usability win. Fast cold start itself is supported only by that single community comment, with no first-party startup-time claims or measurements. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of cold-start or model-load latency, benchmarked time-to-first-token from process launch, independent hands-on startup timing data.
